McDonnell (Tipperary) | attendance = | weather = Sunny | previous = [[1994 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final|1994]] | next = [[1996 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final|1996]] }} The '''1995 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final''' was a [[hurling]] match played on 9 July 1995 at [[Semple Stadium]], [[Thurles]], [[County Tipperary]]. It was contested by [[Clare county hurling team|Clare]] and [[Limerick county hurling team|Limerick]]. Clare claimed their first [[Munster Senior Hurling Championship|Munster Championship]] since [[1932 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|1932]] and fourth ever, after beating Limerick on a scoreline of 1–17 to 0–11. Clare were leading the game by 1–5 to 0–7 at [[half-time]].{{cite web|url=http://www.gaa.ie/about-the-gaa/our-games/hurling/iconic-moments/|title=1995 CLARE'S ALL IRELAND WIN|date=|work=Gaa.ie|accessdate=29 August 2012|archive-date=7 August 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120807015613/http://www.gaa.ie/about-the-gaa/our-games/hurling/iconic-moments/|url-status=dead}} With the scores at 0–5 to 0–3 in Clare's favour in the first half, [[Davy Fitzgerald]] scored from a penalty five minutes before the break, crashing the ball high into the net at the town end before sprinting back to his goal-line. In 2005, this penalty goal came fifth in the [[Top 20 GAA Moments]] poll by the Irish public.{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OLkZDAhNn38 |title=Top 20 GAA Moments|date=|work=Youtube|accessdate=29 August 2012 }} Clare were captained by [[Anthony Daly (hurler)|Anthony Daly]] and managed by [[Ger Loughnane]] in his first year.{{cite web|url=http://www.the42.ie/clare-hurling-1995-2205595-Jul2015/|title=20 years ago today the Clare hurlers won a famous Munster title…but where are they now?|date=9 July 2015|work=The 42|accessdate=10 March 2016}} Clare had defeated [[Cork county hurling team|Cork]] in the semi-final by 2–13 to 3–09 to reach the final, while Limerick had defeated [[Tipperary county hurling team|Tipperary]] by 0–16 to 0–15 in their semi-final.{{cite web|url=http://www.gaainfo.com/comp.php?co=intercounty&year=1995&comp=mshc|title=1995 Munster Hurling Championship|work=Gaainfo.ie|accessdate=29 August 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120923234857/http://www.gaainfo.com/comp.php?co=intercounty&year=1995&comp=mshc|archive-date=2012-09-23|url-status=dead}} The match was screened live by [[RTÉ]] as part of ''[[The Sunday Game]]'' programme, with commentary by [[Ger Canning]] and analysis by [[Éamonn Cregan]]. ==Match== ===Details=== {{footballbox |date = 9 July
